notes.title: Hotfix 1.00.00.149 - Cubes for synth keys, much faster hits
notes.content:
- Added and defaulted to cubes for synth keys. This allows for more natural playing/sustaining notes when hands/sticks are in the cube, no accidental double hits and hit from any direction
- The original pad synth key can be used as an option from the synth info, this will give more percussive response as you hit 'through' the pad
- The original pad is now bi-directional so moving fast back and forwards through it gives you fast note playing
- All synth pads can now be played by swiping through the pads with your hands to create strums (this used to be just available on the harp mode).
- Synth key hits are now much more responsive with flams possible.
- Fixed drop down visibility for JUCE based plugins like tunefish.

notes.content:
[h1]Update v1.00.00.30[/h1]

[h2]Features[/h2]

[list]
[*] New harp mode for synth keys, harp strings animate/have physics when hit and follow the release time of the synth. Selectable from the synth info/settings popup
[*] Avatar recordings can now have interaction turned on, so you can replay a performance triggering loops, editing FX and hitting drums etc..
[*] Valve index and WMR controller mappings are now much better and use the new SteamVR input system. This also makes it much easier to create your own mappings from Steam.
A big thank you goes out to Virtuonaute for beta testing the Valve Index integration. Check out his twitch channel! [url=https://www.twitch.tv/virtuonaute]https://www.twitch.tv/virtuonaute[/url]
[/list]
[h2]Fixes[/h2]

[list]
[*] Fixed save and load of synth control panel positions
[*] Synth presets now use the same browser as clips
[*] Smoother transitions between loops in the clip browser
[*] Better arms/ik for all mixamo style avatars
[*] Better animations for XBot and YBot
[*] Better avatar animations generally and avatars no longer obscure view when moving head around or walking around quickly
[*] Avatar walking animations are scaled by movement speed
[*] Fixed multiplayer 3D controls not visible in clients
[*] Faster enumeration of content/worlds/avatars etc.
[*] Displaying the avatar browser no longer causes the framerate to slow down
[*] Teleporting when pointing at a wall now locates the player 1m away from the wall (cannot teleport into wall)
[*] New locations for all popup windows
[*] Popup windows dim in the distance
[*] Better text when seen at a distance
[*] Fixed occasional movement glitch when going from walking around IRL to smooth locomotion
[*] Camera and screen re-enabled for WMR headsets
[*] New mappings for Valve Index controllers
[*] Better mappings for WMR controllers (joysticks work for smooth locomotion)
[*] Custom hand calibration in settings (fine tune hand position)
[*] Now restarts on changing user audio folder
[*] Option to playback interaction in avatar recorder
[*] Fixed count in on longer avatar recordings
[*] Fixed issue where synth key not triggered when other hand pointing at the key
[*] Additional Afghan atmos world which uses the new Unreal atmosphere system
[*] Multiplayer collaborative editing improved. Whoever clicked the step sequencer last owns the step sequencer input (recording and active cue)
[*] Fixed video display on mini display above step sequencer.
[*] Arm menus now only disabled when grabbing objects rather than when controller is grabbed
[*] World load is now much faster

notes.title: New clip library now live
notes.content:
[h1]The new clip browser is now live in v0.01.00.07 [/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35093235/c925d12194f3c919ba107ba75ff6a820dc8afc26.png[/img]


Although the old clip browser was fun, and massive! it wasn't practical finding and auditioning the clips you want. 
[h2]
The new clip browser adds:[/h2]

[list]
[*] Keyword based searching (Snare/Kick/Bass Music etc..) Genre is combined with Instrument (So Snare AND Bass Music will display only clips that have both categories, Snare AND Kicks will give you both instruments)
[*] Type in a search term, this applies on top of the keyword based filters
[*] Filter by user audio and internal library
[*] Filter by Loops and One-Shots
[*] Click on the open icon to open a clip (if the browser is opened inside an existing clip, this will set the existing clip to the selected new clip)
[*] Click on play icon to play clip, Loops will cue on the beat, One-shots play immediately.
[*] Click 'Browse' in the properties to open the clip library on any existing clip. You can then preview/audition and load the sound directly into the current clip. Great for changing drum sounds already programmed up for example.
[*][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35093235/e7466f5561134d28cab1e3d0d0b21f705fd78b8f.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35093235/402d6a50e6f3bc31a6bd23a90fb727c3fd091c8a.png[/img][/url]
[*] User audio is now categorised as one shots vs loops on load
[*] User audio folder can be changed from the clip browser
[/list]


[h2]Other fixes[/h2]

[list]
[*] Moved advanced tutorial start buttons behind presenter
[*] Removed weird popup behind camera screen
[*] Fixed a crash when leaving world halfway through plugins enumerating
[/list]

notes.title: New features and fixes (magnifying glass on plugins, new tutorial)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35093235/81e57c0ba8e164d7e40f2054f7fda3487776b442.png[/img]

notes.title: VST3 Plugin Support is here!
notes.content:
[h1]VST3 Support is now active[/h1]

What does this mean?

VST3 support means you can use any VST3 compatible plugin in Tranzient. This is for both audio effects and virtual instruments/synths. 

The UI for the plugin is mirrored and can be controlled directly from VR. In addition, plugin parameters can be loop recorded and mapped directly to 3D motion controls for expressive performance.

In multiplayer, any users that have the same plugins installed will also see them in the session.

See https://www.kvraudio.com/plugins/windows/vst3-plugins/instruments/effects/free/most-popular for a list of free VST plugins.

[h3]Additional features and fixes[/h3]

[list]
[*] Settings popups are now pinnable
[*] Arm controls are hidden in the camera output
[*] Avatar animations are restricted for the user's view only, but still visible in the camera and to other users in multiplayer. This means fewer obstructions to the user's view when moving around.
[*] Synth notes are now directly programmable into the step sequencer
[*] Camera can optionally run on rails with user-configurable speed, scale and position
[*] Audio FX bypass state is now saved and loaded with the session
[*] Mixer/plugin clock is now paused when HMD is taken off
[*] The Desktop window mirror can now be controlled from VR
[*] Clip browser smaller/easier to read
[*] Discord button in settings added to link directly to the Tranzient Discord invite.
[*] Fixed 3D control from motion controllers not mapping to scene audio FX parameters
[*] WASAPI exclusive mode audio driver support added - Works at 240 samples for Oculus (5ms), 256 samples with the Vive for low latency performance.
[*] VST3 audio FX available on internal synth
[*] Optionally physically modelled cables can be turned on so routing between the step sequencer and instruments easier to understand.
[*] Save/Load session now saves and loads global key and scale
[*] Choosing a user audio folder no longer pauses the game rendering
[/list]

notes.title: IMPORTANT: hotfix for WMR headsets
notes.content:
v0.0.07.41

This release fixes crashes with Windows Mixed Reality and the latest version of Windows 10.

The fix for the moment is that WMR support has been changed to use SteamVR and Windows Mixed Reality for Steam. 

This is because the issue is with the WMR support built into Unreal Engine.

Because of this change, the controller mapping is slightly different to the tutorials.

Now use the touchpad not the joystick for locomotion and teleportation.

Click the top of the right touchpad to teleport. Click left and right edges of the left touchpad to turn.

Touch the touchpad to move smoothly.
